comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Scorch (2-knob). build.py reads THIS file; manifest.json is the 6-knob desktop-preview manifest. Tone stack + cab are baked (cab as 5 biquads, not the desktop FIR, to stay relocation-free).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).
fxid_comment: 0x01C9. Reverted from 479 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 479 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade. Renamed from 'Level' so every effect in the pack ends with the same control.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
